text:
incident-bot: ALERT: KV-cache free_blocks dropped sharply in us-west-2. Continuous-batching throughput spike detected (x3 normal) starting 1801234500. Elevated 5xx count and tail latency across /v1/generate. Severity: P2. Auto-remediation attempted: capped batch_size -> FAILED (config rejected).

Jen (runtime): seeing the same on dashboards. Cache size jumped then OOMs on a few hosts. Looks like a continuous-batching regression + missed eviction pressure.

Priya (ML): this aligns with the new contextual-batch heuristic we rolled yesterday. If batch growth isn't bounded by prefix keys, KV blocks can blow up. Suggest immediate disable of continuous-batching or enforce strict max_tokens_per_batch.

Carlos (SRE): action plan: 1) Disable continuous-batching for serving pool redwood-infer-uw2; 2) Apply block_manager eviction temporary policy -> aggressive LRU trim 2x; 3) Run block metadata scrub to check for leak.

Alice K (oncall): I'm taking the on-call. I'll do step 1 and 2 now. Posting steps here for handoff.

Marcus (infra): if we flip continuous-batching off, expect higher p99 CPU but should reduce KV memory churn. Can we hotpatch the config via /api/v1/admin/configs? If not, we can push a runtime flag.

Jen (runtime): hotpatch endpoint exists. Using admin token. Command:

```bash
curl -X POST $ADMIN_URL/configs/hotpatch -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"service":"redwood-infer-uw2","continuous_batching":false}'
```

Carlos (SRE): also running a targeted eviction on hosts with >85% KV utilization:

```bash
ssh ops@host-uw2-0 'sudo /opt/redwood/bin/blockmgr --evict --policy aggressive --target-percent 60'
```

Priya (ML): quick note — there is a known corner case where metadata headers grow per-request if context_keys aren't deduped. If the metadata leak is real, eviction won't fully recover until we rotate blocks. We should capture block metadata counts: `curl $METRICS/blockmgr/summary`.

Alice K (oncall): running hotpatch now. Will report outcome in ~2m. tagging @Marcus for infra-level rollback if hotpatch fails. :crossed_fingers:

deploy-bot: hotpatch request received for redwood-infer-uw2 by Alice K. CI checks passed. Starting rollout to 25% of hosts.

(2 minutes pass)

Alice K (oncall): hotpatch applied to 25%. Early signal: tail latency down ~12%, KV growth plateauing on patched hosts. However unpatched hosts still show high memory.

Jen (runtime): ok good. Start a progressive rollout to 100% but pause if error rate climbs. Also push a temporary safety cap in runtime: `max_batch_tokens=1024`. That will limit runaway growth.

Carlos (SRE): eviction jobs finished on the most affected hosts. Freed ~28% KV usage on those nodes. Running metadata scrub next: `blockmgr --scrub --since 1801234400`

Priya (ML): I'm opening a quick revert PR for the contextual-batch heuristic that introduced the bug. We should coordinate canary of the revert in staging, then prod if needed.

Marcus (infra): rolling patch to 100% now. Observability configured to auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.5% for >2m.

(3 minutes pass)

Alice K (oncall): patch at 100%. System p50/p95 improved, p99 better but still slightly elevated. No new OOMs reported in the last 5m. Customers A, B saw degraded performance between 1801234505-1801234590; support notified.

Jen (runtime): follow-up items: - add unit test for dedupe of context_keys; - ensure `continuous_batching` has a global max tokens cap by default; - add metric for per-prefix block growth.

Priya (ML): important: we observed non-zero delta in block metadata counts after scrub -> indicates possible metadata leak. We need a deeper postmortem to trace allocation path. I'll attach eval logs.

Carlos (SRE): temporary mitigations summary placed in incident runbook: disabled continuous-batching, aggressive eviction, scrubbed metadata, hotpatch cap. I'll keep periodic checks on KV utilization for 24h.

deploy-bot: rollout to 100% complete. No rollback triggered.

Alice K (oncall): handing off to Jen for runtime root-cause and to Priya for ML-side revert + postmortem. My notes: impacted hosts: host-uw2-[0..6], customer-facing error window: ~85s, immediate mitigations succeeded. I'm logging a pagerduty follow-up.

Jen (runtime): taking postmortem lead on runtime/instrumentation. Will create an internal incident doc and schedule a 30-min quick sync.

Priya (ML): taking lead on model heuristic revert and tests. Will coordinate with runtime team to validate block growth in staging.

Carlos (SRE): I'll leave monitoring alerts on for 48h and then reduce noise if stable. Also adding a short-term dashboard for per-prefix block allocations.

Marcus (infra): recommend adding a safe-mode flag for hotpatch failures (auto-fallback) so the admin endpoint doesn't cause partial states. Filing infra ticket.

Alice K (oncall): thanks all. Closing live mitigation loop. If anyone sees new regressions ping here. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
